comment: Dr. Gross is the nicest professor I have ever had. She cares a lot about her students, and wants you to succeed. Had her for both PSYC200 and 299. She works so hard as she teaches at both UR and UVA and commutes to teach here. I hope she's doing well and hope to have her again if she ever teaches a lab as assistant professor in the future.

It is a statistic class. All textbook based. If you want an good grade, it is fairly possible. But you still need to spend time on it. Dr. Gross is a very nice and helpful professor. If you ask questions, she will be willing to help.
